people.role: Guide of the eastern passes; once a Pavilion mine guard
people.appearance: Mine guard's squint; hides a limp on level ground.
people.backstory: Orphaned by a Dạ Quang raid and raised on a spear, he guarded the Silver Thread mine for the Pavilion until 1162 and walked off the post that night, leaving two men to hold the shaft mouth, the year Tầm Kiếm opened its door. Tịch Lang Tung (tich_lang_tung) gave him the eastern passes; he has never lost a client or found a cave.

people.appearance: Chalk to the elbows; one eye screwed shut whenever he reads a map.
people.backstory: He keeps the map wall for Tiêu Vấn Phong (tieu_van_phong) and marked all 412 of his notches. He knows Hách Tùng (hach_tung) sells copies, and draws small wrong turns into the wall to see which ones come back.

ties.note: the head he keeps the wall for

people.role: Pavilion Frost Test failure who followed Thang Phục Tuyết to the lodge
people.appearance: Hair parted as the Pavilion parts it; goes absent mid-drill, as if the lesson had not reached him.
people.backstory: He failed the Frost Test twice and came to the lodge because Thang Phục Tuyết (thang_phuc_tuyet) had failed it three times and was teaching anyway. He still breathes the Pavilion's primer every morning, out of habit, and loses his place halfway through.

people.role: Miner's son who cuts steps on the ice stair of Hồi Lộ Phong
people.appearance: Rock dust in the lines of his palms; a pickaxe swing in his walk.
people.backstory: He grew up in the Silver Thread shafts with Đường Tiểu Kiếm (duong_tieu_kiem) and cuts new steps on the ice stair each spring for Lữ Hồi Lộ (lu_hoi_lo). He tells Lữ the steps follow the old line, but cuts them toward his own guess about the cave; Vạn Kiên Bối (van_kien_boi) lost his boot and a week's wage down the crevice.

people.role: Hunter's boy from the oriole valley; Hách Tùng's runner
people.appearance: Ears that go red when he is praised; the satchel strap is worn through.
people.backstory: A hunter's boy raised half-wild, he was brought by Hách Tùng (hach_tung) from the oriole valley and pays him in copper to carry papers down to Hòe Âm. He does not know they are copies of the map wall, and is proud to be trusted.

ties.note: pays him to carry the map copies

people.role: Porter for the guides' envoy parties
people.appearance: Thick porter's neck; counts a belt of knotted cords when nervous.
people.backstory: He carries for Tịch Lang Tung's (tich_lang_tung) envoy parties with Ngưu Phá Sơn (nguu_pha_son), and every spring carries Tịch's basket of mushrooms to the hermitage's gate without being told who it is for. He lets Ngưu Phá Sơn (nguu_pha_son) carry the heavy half of every load and takes the wage for both.

people.role: Sài Mộ Kiếm's best pupil in the sword yard
people.appearance: Fresh shave over an old scar on the jaw.
people.backstory: He spars with Sài Mộ Kiếm (sai_mo_kiem) every dawn and knows the guest elder trains for Tư Không Hạc Niên (tu_khong_hac_nien), not for the hall. He means to go with him to Tống Khách Thị when the day comes. A Hòe Âm carter's son, he broke a yard boy's fingers in a bout last winter because the boy had once beaten him.
